title: Fluvv ingestion extension
description: Validates the `value` of the `sources`, `transform`, `ingestion_config` and `businessMetrics` customProperties entries that Fluvv adds to an otherwise-vanilla ODCS v3.x contract. See docs/fluvv/SPEC.md.

id.description: Local alias for this source. The pipeline registers the source's data as a temp view under this name, referenced in transform.sql's FROM/JOIN clauses.

contract.description: Repo-relative path to the Fluvv contract governing this source (e.g. contracts/bronze/sales/cars.yaml), or null when the source is pre-contract (e.g. a landing zone).

location.description: Storage path this source is read from. Required when `contract` is null; must be omitted when `contract` is set (it is derived from that contract's `servers`).

format.description: Storage format of this source, e.g. csv, delta, parquet, json. Required when `contract` is null; must be omitted when `contract` is set (it is derived from that contract's `servers`).

options.description: Optional format-specific read options, e.g. {header: true, delimiter: ","} for csv.

read.description: Name of the ingestion framework's reader function used to read this source, e.g. spark_read_file. Exported as-is into the ingestion_config JSON the framework dispatches on.

transform.description: Optional per-source step: a SELECT that may reference only this source's own `id`. Its result replaces that view before the contract-level transform runs. Use it to shape one table (select, filter, rename, dedup); combine sources in the contract-level transform.

engine.description: Execution engine for `sql`. Extensible in future spec revisions.

sql.description: A SELECT statement (or CTE chain). Per source: may reference only that source's own `id`. Contract-level: queries the views registered from `sources` (joins, unions, aggregates) and produces this contract's `schema`; optional only when there is exactly one source.

write.description: Name of the ingestion framework's writer function used to write this contract's transform output to its `servers` location, e.g. spark_write_file.

mode.description: Optional Spark write mode for this contract's target. Defaults to overwrite. Only set to append for a target meant to accumulate raw history across runs (e.g. a bronze layer reading a landing zone that may re-deliver records) -- a transform that fully recomputes a dedup/aggregation over its sources each run (e.g. a silver layer's ROW_NUMBER() dedup) must stay on overwrite, or its own declared quality rules (e.g. uniqueness) can fail on rerun.

description.description: Optional. What the metric means, pushed as the OpenMetadata Metric entity's own description.

sql.description: A scalar-returning SELECT statement, run against this contract's own target table to compute the metric's current value. Not executed by OpenMetadata -- fluvv runs it and pushes the result (Section 6.1).

metricType.description: OpenMetadata's own Metric.metricType enum, reused as-is rather than inventing a parallel one.
